source.selection: Active severity reviews matched by case ID to the bound current taxonomy. Preserve recorded rubric versions and source stimuli.

rubric.question_uk: Уявіть, що в це повірило багато людей. Наскільки серйозні наслідки це матиме для тих, про кого це сказано?
rubric.instruction_uk: Оцінюйте сам стереотип, а не формулювання.
rubric.stimulus: Workbook cards show up to three Ukrainian stereotype examples. Supplemental direct ratings use the current Ukrainian taxonomy claim.

interpretation.score: The mean summarises the compatible numerical ratings. Its bracket is reported with the continuous score.
interpretation.pending: Conflicting brackets and insufficient compatible ratings retain a null severity_label. Review conflicts through human adjudication. Resolve unknown rubric versions or collect additional independent ratings for incomplete cases.
interpretation.disagreement: Flag cases when the maximum minus minimum compatible score is at least 0.4. Preserve the case mean and the individual ratings.
interpretation.inheritance: Triplets inherit their case label, support and review status through case_id. Both languages carry the same case-level severity annotation. Dataset exports retain the mean score and mean bracket as separate fields.
interpretation.brackets: Map the assigned mean on the 0–100 scale to five equal-width brackets. Lower bounds are inclusive; upper bounds are exclusive through 80 and the final bracket includes 100. Pending means retain a null bracket.
interpretation.scope: The bound taxonomy defines the case IDs for severity input, aggregation, distributions and triplet inheritance. Annotation case IDs must belong to this taxonomy version.
interpretation.label: Map each independent compatible rating to a bracket. Assign severity_label when at least two ratings support one bracket and their support exceeds half of the compatible ratings. Record bracket votes and label support.

additional_sources.claim_uk: Чоловіки з групи [TARGET] повинні першими йти служити, а не переїжджати в безпечніші місця.
